segments.text: Many people imagine a heart attack as something that happens in a second, like in the
segments.englishExplanation: Many people picture a heart attack as an instantaneous event, like in films.
segments.turkishExplanation: Birçok insan kalp krizini saniyeler içinde gerçekleşen bir şey gibi hayal eder, tıpkı

segments.englishExplanation: Continuing from the previous line: as shown in movies.

segments.text: Sometimes that's true, some heart attacks strike suddenly, but many people have warning
segments.englishExplanation: While some attacks do strike suddenly, many offer early signals.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bazen bu doğrudur, bazı kalp krizleri aniden vurur; ancak birçok insanda uyarı

segments.text: signs and symptoms hours, days, or weeks in advance.
segments.englishExplanation: These warning signals can appear hours, days, or weeks beforehand.
segments.turkishExplanation: işaretleri ve semptomları saatler, günler veya haftalar öncesinden ortaya çıkar.

segments.englishExplanation: People experiencing this might feel an unusual level of fatigue.

segments.text: short of breath, or notice pressure in the chest.
segments.englishExplanation: They may have trouble breathing or experience chest tightness.
segments.turkishExplanation: nefes darlığı çekebilir veya göğüste baskı hissedebilirler.

segments.text: Because these signs can be mild, people often ignore them.
segments.englishExplanation: Since these symptoms can be faint, people often disregard them.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bu belirtiler hafif olabileceğinden, insanlar sıklıkla bunları görmezden gelir.

segments.text: Doctors say that paying attention to the body's small messages can make a big difference.
segments.englishExplanation: Doctors emphasize that paying attention to small body signals can significantly change outcomes.
segments.turkishExplanation: Doktorlar, vücudun küçük mesajlarına dikkat etmenin büyük bir fark yaratabileceğini söylüyor.

segments.text: Listening early is always better than waiting.
segments.englishExplanation: Listening to your body early is far better than delaying response.
segments.turkishExplanation: Erkenden kulak vermek her zaman beklemekten iyidir.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to describe something happening before a specific future time or event.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir olayın öncesinde, önceden gerçekleştiğini belirtmek için kullanılan bir ifadedir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: You should book your ticket in advance to get a lower price.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Daha düşük bir fiyat almak için biletinizi önceden ayırtmalısınız.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Experiencing difficulty breathing or feeling winded.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Nefes almakta zorlanma veya nefessiz kalma durumunu ifade eder.
learningPoints.exampleEn: He felt short of breath after walking up five flights of stairs.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Beş kat merdiven çıktıktan sonra nefes darlığı hissetti.
